name: Hypoglycemia

category.name: General Systemic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with a board-certified endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
It must specifically include frequency of episodes, symptoms, all testing performed, diagnosis, treatment, and likelihood of recurrent hypoglycemia.
Results of all testing (e.g. lab work, imaging) performed for this
Copies of records to include (if applicable):
Clinic visits (progress notes) including other specialty evaluations

rows.label: A
rows.condition: Associated with diabetes mellitus or diabetes medication
rows.condition_html: A. Associated with diabetes mellitus or diabetes medication

rows.label: B
rows.condition: Asymptomatic and incidental findings on labs ONLY OR A single episode due to a specific cause which is unlikely to recur. Examples: decreased intake in setting of extreme exercise (marathon), critical illness
rows.condition_html:
B.

Asymptomatic and incidental findings on labs ONLY

OR

A single episode due to a specific cause which is unlikely to recur.

Examples: decreased intake in setting of extreme exercise (marathon), critical illness
rows.evaluation_data: The AME should review any applicable records: - Hospital History & Physical (H&P); - Hospital discharge summary; - Emergency Department notes; - Office visit notes; and - Lab or other testing results. If the AME can determine that the condition has fully resolved without sequelae, with no evidence of or concern for recurrence or problems that would interfere with flight duties:
rows.evaluation_data_html:
The AME should review any applicable records:

  • Hospital History & Physical (H&P);
  • Hospital discharge summary;
  • Emergency Department notes;
  • Office visit notes; and
  • Lab or other testing results.

If the AME can determine that the condition has fully resolved without sequelae, with no evidence of or concern for recurrence or problems that would interfere with flight duties:
rows.disposition: ISSUE Annotate this information in Block 60.

rows.label: C
rows.condition: Single episode WITHOUT specific cause OR Multiple episodes (recurrent) OR Hypoglycemia related to metabolic disorder Note: If a secondary cause is identified (e.g. adrenal insufficiency, hypothyroidism, or tumor), see that page.

Results of all testing (e.g. lab work, imaging) performed for this
